questions.stem: What is the role of competition in natural selection?

options.text: Competition has no effect on natural selection
Competition for resources means not all organisms survive, and those best adapted are more likely to succeed
All organisms compete equally and have the same chance of survival
Competition only occurs between different species

questions.explanation: Organisms compete for limited resources such as food, water, and territory. Those with advantageous characteristics are more likely to win this competition, survive, and reproduce.
